feed.title: Track Awesome Agriculture Updates Weekly
feed.subtitle: Open source technology for agriculture, farming, and gardening

entry.title: Awesome Agriculture Updates on Nov 23 - Nov 29, 2026
entry.content:
Automation and Robotics

  • Sowbot (⭐104) - Open-hardware seeding and weeding robot for smallholder agroecological farms, with a ROS 2 stack.

Climate, Environment and Weather

  • MAgPIE (⭐145) - Global land-use allocation model linking agricultural production, land use and environmental impacts.
  • SoilHive Core (⭐9) - Federated platform for discovering, harmonising and sharing soil datasets across institutions.

Crop Modeling, Phenotyping, and Pathology

  • apsimNGpy (⭐37) - Python interface for running and analysing APSIM Next Generation simulations.
  • Contour Alley Designer (⭐0) - Field-scale agroforestry design model (contour alley cropping, shelterbelts, silvopasture) that simulates 40 years on real terrain and soils. Research software in development.
  • CroptimizR (⭐32) - R package for parameter estimation and uncertainty analysis of crop models.
  • DSSAT (⭐240) - Decision Support System for Agrotechnology Transfer cropping system model.
  • Epicrop.jl - Crop disease epidemic simulation using a compartmental (HLIP) model, in Julia.
  • FielDHub (⭐60) - R/Shiny app for designing agricultural field experiments.
  • Phenomenal (⭐45) - 3D plant phenotyping and organ segmentation from multi-view images.
  • PlantGL (⭐81) - Geometric library for modelling and visualising plant architecture.

Regional Data / Nepal

  • Nepal Open Farm Data (⭐0) - District figures for coffee, tea, large cardamom, apple, plum and related crops from the Nepal agriculture ministry (MoALD) statistical yearbooks, as CC BY 4.0 CSV.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • FoodOn (⭐249) - Open ontology for food, food sources and food processing.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • AnimalTrakker - Mobile record keeping for sheep and goat flocks.
  • DigiAgriApp - Field and orchard data management server with sensor and remote-sensing integration.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • Mycodo (⭐3.3k) - Environmental monitoring and regulation for mushrooms, hydroponics and greenhouses.
  • OpenSprinkler (⭐569) - Firmware for the open irrigation controller.
  • Smart Irrigation (⭐572) - Home Assistant integration that schedules irrigation from evapotranspiration.

Markets and Food Systems / United States

  • FoodCoopShop (⭐124) - Ordering and stock software for food co-ops and local farm shops.
  • foodsharing - Platform behind foodsharing.de, coordinating volunteers who rescue surplus food.
  • Foodsoft (⭐361) - Ordering, accounting and member management for non-profit food co-ops.
  • Juntagrico (⭐55) - Management platform for community-supported agriculture: memberships, shares, deliveries and work shifts.
  • Karrot - Organising tool for grassroots groups that save and share food.
  • Open Food Network (⭐1.3k) - Online marketplace for farmers and food hubs to sell directly to eaters.
  • OpenOlitor (⭐20) - Administration software for community-supported agriculture initiatives.
  • Teikei (⭐66) - Map platform connecting consumers with community-supported agriculture (CSA) farms.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • OpenDroneMap (⭐6.6k) - Drone image processing into orthomosaics, elevation models and plant health maps.
  • sentinel-crop-pipeline (⭐5) - Reproducible Sentinel-2 L2A data preparation for crop-classification models: scene discovery, cloud masking, patches, spatially blocked splits and label masks, with an optional Gemini or Claude scene filter.
  • WebODM (⭐4.3k) - Web interface for processing and sharing OpenDroneMap drone surveys.

entry.title: Awesome Agriculture Updates on Nov 16 - Nov 22, 2026
entry.content:
Automation and Robotics

  • Feldfreund Dev Kit (⭐11) - Open source development platform for autonomous outdoor robotics and agricultural weeding.
  • Field Mission Planner (⭐5) - Open-source spraying route planner for ArduPilot drones (coverage routes around obstacles, MAVLink upload, offline).
  • ROS Agriculture - Open Source community focusing on using Robot Operating System to empower farmers with robotics tools.

Calculators

  • CoverCalc Pro Landscape Quantity Kit (⭐0) - MIT-licensed offline browser checker for landscape volumes and whole-bag counts.
  • Direct Beef Tools (⭐0) - Browser-only worksheet for comparing another-sale net value with direct-to-customer beef break-even and target prices.
  • flower-farm-math (⭐0) - Zero-dependency JavaScript library for flower farm and farmer-florist math: wedding stem counts, costs-up CSA bouquet pricing, and a bloom-to-sales weekly reconciliation of stems cut vs. promised by variety.
  • mycro-grow (⭐0) - JavaScript library and CLI for gourmet mushroom cultivation math: substrate hydration, spawn ratio, biological-efficiency yield, and batch economics.
  • yard-material-coverage-data (⭐1) - Open landscape material coverage, density, and bag conversion data with a reusable calculator component.

Crop Modeling, Phenotyping, and Pathology

  • Open Plant Pathology - A community that values open data and computational tools for advancing epidemiology and pathogen population biology and ecology.

Research and General Data

  • Furrow - Farmland prices in 37 countries on 6 continents from national statistics.
  • Robot Lawn Mower Specs - CC BY 4.0 dataset of robotic mower specifications with cited sources and CSV/JSON downloads.
  • SoybeanYield (⭐162) - A multimodal agricultural dataset for soybean yield forecasting, integrating yield performance, management practices, weather data, and soil parameters.

Regional Data / India

  • India Agri Export Price Index - Weekly reference prices for Indian agri exports (USD/kg from UN Comtrade, INR/quintal mandi prices from Agmarknet) with sources, an append-only history and CSV/JSON downloads.
  • India Land Data (⭐1) - Official land-record portals for 11 Indian states and Indian land area units (gunta, bigha, kanal and others) with state variations, as CC BY 4.0 JSON.
  • VarshaKrishi Field NDVI - One year of Sentinel-2 NDVI for a farm field near Katol, India, with field-level cloud and haze flags (CC BY 4.0, CSV/JSON).

Regional Data / United States

  • massachusetts-frost-dates-zones (⭐0) - CC BY 4.0 CSV datasets of Massachusetts frost dates from NOAA normals and USDA hardiness zones for towns and villages.
  • US Farmers Market Statistics - USDA-derived state-by-state farmers market counts and SNAP/EBT and organic-vendor statistics, with CC BY 4.0 CSV/JSON downloads.
  • USDA Market Prices - Daily USDA boxed beef, pork and fed cattle prices by cut and region, with history since 2020 and free CSV downloads, in English and Spanish.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • Agro GPS MCP (⭐0) - MCP server exposing the official plant protection product registers of 30 European countries (authorisation status, active substances, authorised uses per crop) to AI assistants; free, no key.
  • ClearAg API Examples (⭐2) - A collection of code examples using the ClearAg APIs.
  • ISO-15143-3-API-OAuth2-CSharp-Example (⭐0) - C# example for the John Deere ISO 15143-3 machine data API.
  • Open Agri Common Semantic Model (OCSM) (⭐7) - Ontology reusing existing standards to support semantic interoperability across smart farming solutions.
  • Open-Agriculture - Free and open source ISOBUS (ISO 11783) tools, including the AgIsoStack++ library, a Virtual Terminal, a DDOP editor and a VT object pool designer.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-Java-Example (⭐3) - Java example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-NodeJS-Example (⭐3) - Node.js example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • OperationsCenterAPI-OAuth2-Python-Example (⭐22) - Python example for the John Deere Operations Center API.
  • Tilth - Free daily UK fertiliser price index API for nine grades, CC BY 4.0 licensed.
  • Trefle (⭐589) - Open source botanical REST API for querying plant species, taxonomy, and growing information.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • GrowerHub (⭐7) - Greenhouse and small-farm management with Zigbee2MQTT monitoring, plant and watering journals, and lighting and irrigation automation.
  • HortusFox (⭐1.7k) - Self-hosted collaborative plant management system with plant records, care tasks, inventory, photos, and a calendar.
  • Plant-it (⭐1.4k) - Android gardening companion for logging plant care, keeping photos, and setting reminders.
  • Soil Mate (⭐29) - Helper app designed to assist the collection of soil data.
  • Tania (⭐825) - Free and open source farming management system for everyone built with Go and Vue.js.

GIS Platforms / United States

  • AI Segmentation by TerraLab (⭐45) - QGIS imagery segmentation plugin with local interactive processing and optional hosted processing with free-tier limits.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • AgOpenGPS (⭐984) - Ag precision mapping and section control software.

Machine Learning and AI / United States

  • HealthyCropping (⭐4) - Android crop disease diagnosis application in development, using on-device computer vision for offline use.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • Awesome Sentinel (⭐587) - A curated list of awesome tools, tutorials and APIs related to data from the Copernicus Sentinel Satellites.

entry.content:
Research and General Data

  • Agriculture Datasets Collection - Curated collection of machine learning datasets specifically designed to address food security challenges in developing regions.
  • CEAOD - Controlled Environment Agriculture Open Data repository providing standardized datasets for greenhouse and indoor farming research with data analysis tools.
  • CropHarvest (⭐246) - Open source remote sensing dataset for global crop type mapping with 95,186 labeled datapoints from satellite imagery, supporting machine learning research for food security.
  • FAO/NASA Harvest Crop Type Dataset - Ground truth crop type observations dataset with geolocated field data for validation and training of cropland classification models.

entry.title: Awesome Agriculture Updates on Mar 04 - Mar 10, 2019
entry.content:
Climate, Environment and Weather

  • frostline (⭐165) - A dataset, API, and python parser for USDA plant hardiness zones.
  • GSODR (⭐98) - Global summary daily weather data in R.
  • iem (⭐196) - Code that makes the Iowa Environmental Mesonet run.
  • PyETo (⭐179) - Python package for calculating reference/potential evapotranspiration (ETo).
  • pyTSEB (⭐172) - A python two source energy balance model for estimation of evapotranspiration with remote sensing data.
  • soilDB (⭐102) - R library for simplified access to NCSS soil databases.

Data Standardization, Interoperability and APIs / United States

  • AgGateway’s ADAPT Toolkit - Open Source project providing tools to simplify communication between growers, their machines, and their partners.
  • API-Code-Samples (⭐9) - Contains aWhere's API platform code samples.
  • Open Ag Data Alliance - OADA is an open project designed to bring interoperability, security, and privacy to agricultural data.
  • SampleData (⭐39) - Sample datacards, shapefiles, and other files you can use for testing.

Farm Management Systems and Record Keeping / United States

  • Ekylibre (⭐496) - Farm management information system for farmers and small enterprises built with Ruby on Rails and PostgreSQL/PostGIS.
  • farmOS (⭐1.4k) - Web-based farm record keeping application built with Drupal and PHP.

GIS Resources / United States

  • Awesome GIS (⭐5.6k) - Awesome GIS is a list collecting abundant GIS related sources.

GIS Platforms / United States

  • QGIS - QGIS is a free, open source, cross platform (lin/win/mac) geographical information system.

Shapefiles / United States

  • pyshp (⭐1.2k) - Reads and writes ESRI Shapefiles in pure Python.
  • rgeo-shapefile (⭐98) - RGeo Shapefile is an optional module for RGeo for reading geospatial data from ESRI shapefiles in Ruby.

IoT, Hardware / United States

  • OpenMinder (⭐47) - Open Source Rootzone Monitoring, API and open source hat for the RaspberryPi.

Knowledgebases and Learning Resources / United States

  • Harvest Helper (⭐89) - Provides growing, harvesting and recipe information for the 45 plants in the database as well as a JSON API.
  • OpenFarm (⭐1.7k) - A free and open database for farming and gardening knowledge built with Ruby on Rails.

Remote Sensing and Imagery / United States

  • Raster Vision (⭐2.2k) - Deep learning for aerial/satellite imagery.
  • Sen2Agri (⭐133) - Software system processing high resolution satellite images for agricultural purposes.
